brief_ref: §9-10 (matching identity vs source activity ID), §12 (Level 2 multi-field match), §35 (positional-ID MS Project pair)
description: MSPDI (MS Project XML) pair where the display 'ID' column is purely positional: a task is inserted at the top of the new revision, shifting every subsequent task's ID by one (1->2, 2->3, 3->4). None of the three pre-existing tasks share their old ID with their new ID. Matching must succeed by name (the engine's group key), not by the renumbered positional ID — this is the exact ID problem in brief §9.
notes: removed=[] and all 3 pre-existing tasks stay matched despite every one of them changing display ID between revisions -- confirms the engine already does not use the positional ID as an identity key. What it does NOT yet do (tracked for Phase 2, TL-2.5): the output has no field preserving 'previous ID 1 -> current ID 2' for a PM to see why the ID looks like it changed.
